title: ToolSubject
description: What a tool call is about, normalised by the adapter of the engine so that a client reads it the same whatever engine made the call. Every field is optional, and a kind sets the ones it has: the paths of a `file.*`, the command of a `shell`, the pattern of a `search`, the URL of a `web.fetch`.

paths.description: The files the call reads or writes, absolute, as the engine gave them.

command.description: The whole command line of a `shell` — what the IN of the row shows.

pattern.description: What a `search` looks for: the text or the glob.

server.description: The MCP server of an `mcp` call.

tool.description: The tool of that MCP server.

description.description: What an `agent` was sent to do, in the words the model gave.
